prompt: A clean editorial infographic shows a language model as a glowing central processor receiving a flowing sentence that breaks apart into distinct colored tiles—whole short words, word fragments, numbers, punctuation marks and snippets of code—then emitting another stream of tiles that reassemble into text; beside it, a large counter visibly tallies incoming and outgoing tiles as a meter for processing and billing, while a branching background montage of many prompts, drafts and code files suggests accumulated computational effort; in clear visual contrast, a tiny elegant proof and a short accurate answer sit on one side with a green check, while a towering pile of repetitive, garbled pages sits on the other with a red question mark, making clear that token volume measures material handled rather than quality, originality, or truth.
